$ eukcc -h
Usage: eukcc [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...

  Framework to evaluate completeness and contamination of a eukaryotic MAG or
  isolate genome. Only valid for microbial eukaryotes.

Options:
  -q, --quiet    Silence most output
  -d, --debug    Debug and thus ignore safety
  -v, --version  Show the version and exit.
  -h, --help     Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  define_set   Define a marker gene set from a group of genomes.
  folder       Estimate the quality of a folder of bins and refine them.
  ncbi_update  Update the NCBI taxonomy database used by ete3.
  single       Estimate the quality of a single genome or MAG.

$ eukcc single -h
Usage: eukcc single [OPTIONS] FASTA

  Estimate the quality of a single genome or MAG.

Options:
  -o, --out TEXT                Path to output folder (Default: .)
  --db TEXT                     Path to EukCC DB
  -t, --threads INTEGER         Number of threads to use (Default: 1)
  --threads_epa INTEGER         Number of threads to use for epa-ng,
                                recommended: 1 (Default: 1)
  --set_size INTEGER            Minimal number of marker genes in a set,
                                smaller sets are not used (Default: 20)
  --max_set_size INTEGER        Maximal number of marker genes in a set,
                                larger sets are reduced to a fixed random
                                sample of this size. 0 uses all marker genes
                                (Default: 500)
  --marker_prevalence FLOAT     Percentage of the reference species of a set
                                in which a marker gene must be single copy
                                (Default: 95)
  --DNA                         The fasta file contains DNA sequences
  --AA                          The fasta file contains amino acid sequences
  --taxids TEXT                 Taxid to use as set starting point, repeat the
                                option for several taxids
  --genomes TEXT                Genome file to base a SCMG set upon, repeat
                                the option for several genomes
  --use_placement TEXT          Path to previous result file, to use exact
                                same marker gene set
  --set_number_species INTEGER  Minimal number of reference species a set is
                                defined on. Reduce this if no sets can be
                                found (Default: 3)
  --select_best_guess           Use best guess to select marker gene set
                                (Default)
  --select_species              Use species count to select best marker gene
                                set (Default: best guess)
  --use_ncbi_tree               Instead of using the EukCC phylogenetic tree,
                                rely on NCBI taxids (default: False)
  --ignore_tree                 Advanced option, mainly for debugging. Can
                                ignore the tree if genomes are known via
                                taxids for example
  --simple                      Use global DB instead of clade specific dbs
                                (faster, not suitable for protozoa)
  --clade TEXT                  Define clade as base, fungi, protozoa or plant
  -r, --rerun                   Rerun and remove any previously computed data
                                in the target folder
  --no_dynamic_root             Do not re-root tree dynamically, to get best
                                set detection (default: True)
  --extra                       Produce extra output files.
  --keep                        Keep workdir after the run.
  -h, --help                    Show this message and exit.

$ eukcc folder -h
Usage: eukcc folder [OPTIONS] BINFOLDER

  Estimate the quality of a folder of bins and refine them. Bins are the .fa,
  .fna, .fasta files in BINFOLDER, optionally gzip compressed.

Options:
  -o, --out TEXT             Path to output folder (Default: .)
  --db TEXT                  Path to EukCC DB
  -t, --threads INTEGER      Number of threads to use (Default: 1)
  --threads_epa INTEGER      Number of threads to use for epa-ng, recommended:
                             1 (Default: 1)
  --marker_prevalence FLOAT  Percentage of the reference species of a set in
                             which a marker gene must be single copy (Default:
                             95)
  --links TEXT               Path to a link table generated with binlinks.py.
                             If supplied, paired reads will be used to refine
                             bins (Recommended)
  --min_links INTEGER        Number of paired reads matching between bins for
                             merging to happen (default: 100)
  --prefix TEXT              Prefix to add for merged bins (default: merged.)
  --improve_ratio FLOAT      Ratio of completeness to contamination change
                             (Default: 5)
  --improve_percent FLOAT    A merger must increase completeness at least by n
                             percent (Default: 10)
  --n_combine INTEGER        How many small bins should be merged into a
                             medium sized bin (Default: 1)
  -h, --help                 Show this message and exit.

$ eukcc define_set -h
Usage: eukcc define_set [OPTIONS] GENOMES...

  Define a marker gene set from a group of genomes.

Options:
  -o, --out TEXT             Path to output folder (Default: .)
  --db TEXT                  Path to EukCC DB
  -t, --threads INTEGER      Number of threads to use (Default: 1)
  --set_size INTEGER         Minimal number of marker genes in a set, smaller
                             sets are not used (Default: 20)
  --max_set_size INTEGER     Maximal number of marker genes in a set, larger
                             sets are reduced to a fixed random sample of this
                             size. 0 uses all marker genes (Default: 500)
  --marker_prevalence FLOAT  Percentage of the provided genomes in which a
                             marker gene must be single copy (Default: 95)
  -n, --name TEXT            Name of the set (default: set)
  --DNA                      The fasta file contains DNA sequences
  --AA                       All provided files are proteins, no gene
                             prediction will be performed. Omit if input is
                             mixed or genomic
  -h, --help                 Show this message and exit.
